verdict.rationale: Bolna's first-party docs say it supports 40+ languages and that the agent detects and switches language mid-call on its own. The agent tab lets developers add multiple languages, set a default and write a per-language prompt. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how detection and switching work or can be configured (thresholds, API fields), independent or hands-on corroboration of mid-call switching.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run conversations in multiple languages, including detecting and switching language mid-call

citations.quote: 40+ languages including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Bengali with native accents — the agent detects and switches mid-call on its own.
Add multiple languages, set a default, and write a dedicated prompt for each.
the agent detects and switches mid-call on its own
